Halvorsen Supply newsletter — "Warehouse automation in 2026"

• In 2026, warehouse pick rates rose 18% thanks to autonomous carts (main article).
• However, integration of the automation systems took twice as long as planned (main article).
• The biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks (companion piece).

Sources: newsletter@halvorsen.example ("Warehouse automation in 2026"), https://blog.halvorsen.example/2026/warehouse, https://insights.halvorsen.example/warehouse/companion
